explainText:
This run cannot establish which option meets your full brief: key effects remain unsized, and maintaining code quality is unverified. Olumi supplied 27 values; launch-date slippage was treated as zero, not established as absent.

This comparison turns on the links from ‘Developer hires’ to ‘Productivity’, from ‘Team coordination quality’ to ‘Productivity’ and from ‘Onboarding load from new hires’ to ‘Productivity’ and 5 more, whose strengths nobody has set yet. To size them, I first need today’s level of ‘Productivity’.
clarificationText:
That gives us a useful **two-week sprint** as the time unit for productivity. Before recording a baseline, we need to distinguish alternative capacities from a combined workload—I shouldn’t add the figures together or assume how the sizes convert.

Do you mean you can fit **4 large OR 8 medium OR 16 small updates** into a sprint, or **all three together**?
